title: lichen-oscore lib.rs: duplicate SenderStateStore import breaks all rust builds (merge artifact)
description: Found after syncing beads-worker-4 with main (merge brought worker-5's changes, cb4da0789c). rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs has SenderStateStore imported twice: line 19 'pub use oscore::types::{self, SenderStateStore};' and line 41 inside the grouped 'pub use oscore::{...}' — E0252 duplicate name, breaks compile of every dependent crate (lichen-node 324 tests blocked). This is a mechanical merge artifact (duplicate pub use), not an oscore-semantics change, but the file is inside the human-only oscore boundary so filing instead of fixing. Fix: delete the duplicate 'SenderStateStore,' line from the grouped import (line 41) — or from line 19; one-line, zero semantics. Blocks: all rust builds on all worker branches post-sync.
close_reason: Not reproducible on beads-worker-1 at the merge commit it describes: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs has exactly ONE SenderStateStore re-export (line 41 in the grouped pub use oscore::{...}; there is no 'pub use oscore::types::{...}' line 19 — that was the pre-merge worker-4/worker-5 shape). cargo check -p lichen-oscore and the dependent builds pass (lichen-node lib tests ran green earlier this session at commit 3c2dbd7484, including the SenderStateStore-consuming rpl_stack tests). The duplicate-import artifact was evidently resolved during the sync window before this bead was filed, or fixed in whichever tree cb4da0789c's merge landed in. If the reporter still sees E0252, it is a stale checkout — sync and re-run.
